ASSISTANT: Your transfer is complete. I sent $100.00 from your checking account to Alice. The transfer ID is transfer-001. Your checking account balance was $2,000.00 before this transfer.
CUSTOMER: The app showed a timeout and I do not know whether it went through. Please retry the $100.00 transfer to Alice.
ASSISTANT: I checked your transfer history, and the $100.00 transfer to Alice from checking has already completed (transfer ID transfer-001). I have not sent a second transfer, so you won't be charged twice. If you see another $100.00 debit to Alice, please let me know. I also need to correct my earlier message: I didn't verify the $2,000.00 checking balance I quoted, so please don't rely on that figure. Is there anything else I can help with?
